source_of_method.method: FREEZE_C / ASK_PREDECESSOR / WALK_TO_B / FREEZE_A_TO_C_RULES / FORWARD_REPLAY / CONTROL

hypothesis: Searching backward from a fixed observed C using witness constraints, then replaying A→B→C with frozen authoritative edges, can recover more defensible causal paths or reduce cost relative to forward exhaustive and provenance-aware baselines.

experimental_design.dataset_status: DEVELOPER-GENERATED SYNTHETIC ONLY. Same graph template/scenario types across splits; not externally blind or independent physical observations.
experimental_design.input_contract: Visible graph A→B→C authoritative transitions; reverse proposals with explicit completeness certificate; terminal C, synthetic source reports with roots/capture times/clock quality. No scenario label, hidden true path or gold in input.
experimental_design.reference_label: Identify a UNIQUE possible past path ONLY if all other compatible paths are eliminated by two independent, consistent, time-valid simulated witness roots or graph structure. Multiple compatible worlds => ABSTAIN.
experimental_design.witness_root_limit: Simulated strings are not authenticated physical instruments. Correlated copies or missing/contradictory timestamps do not constrain provenance.
experimental_design.backward_index_limit: A simulated 'complete_certified' reverse-proposal index is supplied. If incomplete, reverse arms MUST abstain; the completeness certificate would require external validation in deployment.
experimental_design.budget: Hard 500 counted graph-edge/proposal/replay operations per case for each arm; if exceeded, abstain.

paired_arms.A_FORWARD_ONLY_EXHAUSTIVE: Enumerate all authoritative A→B→C edges and filter corroborated constraints, exact path-set output.
paired_arms.B_REVERSE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED: Enumerate C→B→A proposed predecessor pointers WITHOUT replay (negative control); abstain if predecessor index incomplete.
paired_arms.C_REVERSE_PLUS_FORWARD_REPLAY: Backtrace C→B→A proposals, require index completeness and corroborated constraints; verify each candidate on A→B→C frozen actual edges.
paired_arms.D_STRONG_EXHAUSTIVE_PROVENANCE: Strong transparent exhaustive baseline with identical observations and graph budget; method must show gain over this arm, not only the weak reverse-only control.
paired_arms.E_ALWAYS_ABSTAIN: Null control for selective-accuracy and non-assertion metrics.

primary_metrics: Coverage (answers/total) and conditional selective accuracy among answered
Unsupported positive assertions in oracle-ambiguous cases
Paired gains against strong D at equal safety and equal operation budget
Mean graph-operation count and uncalibrated median decision μs; no unmeasured energy claims
critical_controls: Ambiguous many-to-one causality (A1→B1→C and A2→B1→C), collider shared intermediate
Duplicate/correlated witness roots; incompatible statements; missing timestamps; clock uncertainty
Future plan distinguished from observed terminal; uncertain terminal not promoted
Identical content lacking event identity does not resolve a history
Spurious reverse proposal requires forward replay; incomplete reverse index forces abstention
Hard budget must fail closed, not guess; route remains unchanged by retrospective inference
No model/production changes, no real people or patient records.

epistemic_gates.engineering_pass: CI passes 29 tests and all five arms complete 600 holdout cases with original DemiHead unaffected, zero over-budget unsupported claims.
epistemic_gates.synthetic_gain: Descriptive only if reverse+forward yields strictly greater safe coverage than strong baseline at no higher unsafe errors and accounted cost; no automatic model promotion.
epistemic_gates.scientific_external_pass: Impossible here: independent data provider and external hidden challenge absent.
epistemic_gates.neural_gain: NOT_TESTED: R5F is algorithmic causal search, not a trained neural model.

next_if_no_gain: R5G cost-matched adversarial graph families with real source-provenance blind examination, and demonstrate any computational advantage over optimized exact causal inference, not over deliberately handicapped heuristics.
